title: Efficient and durable perovskite photovoltaics using dibenzothiophene arylamine derivatives for indoor energy harvesting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00293A, Paper
Lal Chand, Prasun Kumar, Rahul Tiwari, Babar Suraj Shivaji, Milon Kundar, Suman Kalyan Pal, Vibha Saxena, Ranbir Singh, Surya Prakash Singh
A high-performing dibenzothiophene-based HTM enabled 33.32% efficiency in indoor photovoltaics under 1000 lux LED illumination. A dopant-free design ensured 91% retention after 200 hours at 80 °C, highlighting superior durability.
